description: This file implements the multi-factor authentication (MFA) setup and management UI for the Notesnook app, including MFA method selection, setup steps, recovery codes, and success confirmation screens.

classes.name: MFAStep
classes.description: Represents a step in the MFA process with an identifier and associated properties.

classes.name: MFAStepProps
classes.description: Props for MFA step components, including recovery flag, success callback, step setter, method, and setup flag.

classes.name: MFAMethod
classes.description: Defines an MFA method with id, title, body, icon, and whether it is recommended.

methods.name: MFAMethodsPickerStep
methods.description: Component for selecting MFA method, filtering options based on recovery mode and feature availability.

methods.name: MFASetup
methods.description: Component for setting up MFA via selected method, handling code input, sending, and verification.

methods.name: MFARecoveryCodes
methods.description: Component displaying recovery codes, allowing copying and saving to file.

methods.name: MFASuccess
methods.description: Component shown upon successful MFA setup, with options to proceed or add secondary MFA method.

methods.name: MFASheet
methods.description: Main component managing MFA setup flow with steps for method selection, setup, recovery codes, and success.
